// copied from planning-tool/backend/prisma/schema.prisma lines 71-171
model Employee {
  id                   String   @id @default(uuid())
  name                 String
  firstName            String?  @map("first_name")
  surname              String?  @map("surname")
  email                String   @unique
  passwordHash         String?  @map("password_hash")
  sapReference         Int      @map("sap_reference")
  supervisorId         String?  @map("supervisor_id")
  organizationalUnitId String?  @map("organizational_unit_id")
  personnelSource      String @default("INTERNAL") @map("personnel_source")
  externalType         String @default("NONE") @map("external_type")
  storageScope         String @default("LOCAL") @map("storage_scope")
  personnelLifecycleState String @default("ACTIVE") @map("personnel_lifecycle_state")
  centralSyncState     String @default("NOT_REQUIRED") @map("central_sync_state")
  centralSyncError     String? @map("central_sync_error")
  centralSyncAttemptedAt DateTime? @map("central_sync_attempted_at")
  personnelCommandKey  String? @map("personnel_command_key")
  startDate            DateTime @map("start_date")
  endDate              DateTime? @map("end_date")
  employeeStatusId     String   @map("employee_status_id")
  resourceTypeId       String   @map("resource_type_id")
  maStatusId           String?  @map("ma_status_id")
  lastKnownVersion     String?  @map("last_known_version")
  createdAt            DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt            DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  authorityVersion     Int      @default(0) @map("authority_version")

  // Relations
  supervisor         Employee?           @relation("EmployeeSupervisor", fields: [supervisorId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  subordinates       Employee[]          @relation("EmployeeSupervisor")
  employeeStatus     CatalogEntry        @relation("EmployeeStatus", fields: [employeeStatusId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  resourceType       CatalogEntry        @relation("ResourceType", fields: [resourceTypeId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  maStatus           CatalogEntry?       @relation("MaStatus", fields: [maStatusId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  roles              UserRole[]
  deputyAssignments  DeputyAssignment[]
  authorityAssignments AuthorityAssignment[]

  // Durable membership-transfer lifecycle.  A pending transfer is a real
  // state transition, not an audit-only hint; it must survive process restart
  // and be protected by a filtered unique index in SQL Server.
  transferRequests       EmployeeTransfer[] @relation("EmployeeTransferTarget")
  requestedTransfers     EmployeeTransfer[] @relation("EmployeeTransferRequester")
  decidedTransfers       EmployeeTransfer[] @relation("EmployeeTransferDecider")

  // Inverse relations — Shared Master Data
  ledProjects              Project[]              @relation("ProjectLeader")
  projectPreferences       EmployeeProjectPreference[]
  ownedPspElements         PspElement[]
  technicalLeadAssignments ProjectTechnicalLead[] @relation("TechLead")
  technicalLeadCreations   ProjectTechnicalLead[] @relation("TechLeadCreator")
  projectMemberships       ProjectMember[]        @relation("ProjectMembership")
  projectMembershipCreations ProjectMember[]      @relation("ProjectMembershipCreator")

  // Inverse relations — Personnel Planning
  assignments              Assignment[]           @relation("AssignmentEmployee")
  assignmentCreations      Assignment[]           @relation("AssignmentCreator")
  lendingAssignments       LendingAssignment[]    @relation("LendingEmployee")
  lendingManagerScopes     LendingAssignment[]    @relation("LendingManager")
  lendingAmendmentRequests LendingAssignmentAmendment[] @relation("LendingAmendmentEmployee")
  absenceRecords           AbsenceRecord[]        @relation("AbsenceEmployee")
  absenceCreations         AbsenceRecord[]        @relation("AbsenceCreator")
  demandCreations          Demand[]
  projectRequests          ProjectRequest[]

  // Inverse relations — Finance
  sapImportRuns            SapImportRun[]
  tplPureCostCreations     TplPlanEntryPureCost[]
  tplResourceCreations     TplPlanEntryResource[]
  limitProfileCreations    LimitProfile[]
  limitCategorySplitCreations  LimitCategorySplit[]
  limitSubElementSplitCreations LimitSubElementSplit[]
  ratingConfigCreations    RatingConfig[]

  // Inverse relations — Capacity
  capacityEntries          CapacityCalendarEntry[] @relation("CapacityEmployee")
  capacityCreations        CapacityCalendarEntry[] @relation("CapacityCreator")

  // Inverse relations — System
  snapshots                Snapshot[]
  auditEvents              AuditEvent[]
  userPreferences          UserPreference[]
  notifications            Notification[]
  milestoneCreations       ProjectMilestone[]     @relation("MilestoneCreator")
  phaseCreations           ProjectPhase[]         @relation("PhaseCreator")
  supportTickets           SupportTicket[]        @relation("EmployeeTickets")

  @@map("employees")
}

model UserRole {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  employeeId String   @map("employee_id")
  role       String
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  employee Employee @relation(fields: [employeeId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)

  @@unique([employeeId, role])
  @@map("user_roles")
}
// copied from planning-tool/backend/prisma/schema.prisma lines 176-223
model EmployeeTransfer {
  id                  String    @id @default(uuid())
  employeeId         String    @map("employee_id")
  requestedById       String    @map("requested_by_id")
  decidedById         String?   @map("decided_by_id")
  fromOrgUnitId       String?   @map("from_org_unit_id")
  targetOrgUnitId     String    @map("target_org_unit_id")
  direction           String    @default("OUTGOING")
  approvalContractVersion Int   @default(2) @map("approval_contract_version")
  requestOrigin       String?   @map("request_origin")
  requestAuthorityProofJson String? @db.NVarChar(Max) @map("request_authority_proof_json")
  sourceApprovalCommandKey String? @map("source_approval_command_key")
  targetApprovalCommandKey String? @map("target_approval_command_key")
  organizationRoleReleasePlanJson String? @db.NVarChar(Max) @map("organization_role_release_plan_json")
  employeeAuthorityRevision Int @default(0) @map("employee_authority_revision")
  status              String    @default("PENDING")
  reason              String?
  commandKey          String    @unique @map("command_key")
  /// The command key of the terminal decision (or requester cancel operation;
  /// historical EXPIRE rows retain their original key for audit only).
  /// It is deliberately separate from the request key so a retry of a
  /// cross-database decision can be recognized without losing request replay.
  lastCommandKey      String?   @map("last_command_key")
  /// The terminal operation bound to lastCommandKey.  A key is an idempotency
  /// identity, not a bearer token that may be reused for a different command.
  lastCommandAction   String?   @map("last_command_action")
  revision            Int       @default(1)
  /// Nullable historical metadata. New PENDING organization transfers do not
  /// have a wall-clock expiry; legacy terminal rows may retain their original
  /// value for audit/history compatibility.
  expiresAt           DateTime? @map("expires_at")
  requestedAt         DateTime  @default(now()) @map("requested_at")
  decidedAt           DateTime? @map("decided_at")
  centralSyncState    String    @default("NOT_REQUIRED") @map("central_sync_state")
  centralSyncError    String?   @map("central_sync_error")
  centralSyncAttemptedAt DateTime? @map("central_sync_attempted_at")
  createdAt           DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt           DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  employee     Employee  @relation("EmployeeTransferTarget", fields: [employeeId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  requestedBy Employee  @relation("EmployeeTransferRequester", fields: [requestedById], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  decidedBy   Employee? @relation("EmployeeTransferDecider", fields: [decidedById], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  commandIdentities EmployeeTransferCommand[]

  @@index([employeeId, status])
  @@index([targetOrgUnitId, status])
  @@map("employee_transfers")
}
// copied from planning-tool/backend/prisma/schema.prisma lines 253-277
model AuthorityAssignment {
  id                  String   @id @default(uuid())
  employeeId          String   @map("employee_id")
  definitionCode      String   @map("definition_code")
  domain              String
  bindingKind         String   @map("binding_kind")
  bindingId           String?  @map("binding_id")
  bindingRootId       String?  @map("binding_root_id")
  bindingMembersJson  String?  @map("binding_members_json")
  identityKey         String   @unique @map("identity_key")
  sourceRef           String   @map("source_ref")
  validFrom           DateTime? @map("valid_from")
  validTo             DateTime? @map("valid_to")
  active              Boolean  @default(true)
  revision            Int      @default(1)
  createdAt           DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt           DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  employee Employee @relation(fields: [employeeId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)

  @@index([employeeId, active])
  @@index([definitionCode, bindingKind, bindingId])
  @@index([sourceRef])
  @@map("authority_assignments")
}
// copied from planning-tool/backend/prisma/schema.prisma lines 1305-1324
model AuditEvent {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  domain     String
  action     String
  entityType String   @map("entity_type")
  entityId   String   @map("entity_id")
  oldValue   String?  @db.NVarChar(Max) @map("old_value")
  newValue   String?  @db.NVarChar(Max) @map("new_value")
  actorId    String   @map("actor_id")
  timestamp  DateTime
  contextId  String?  @map("context_id")
  idempotencyKey String? @map("idempotency_key")
  severity   String
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  // Relations
  actor Employee @relation(fields: [actorId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)

  @@map("audit_events")
}
// copied from planning-tool/backend/prisma/schema.prisma lines 1361-1376
model Notification {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  recipientId String   @map("recipient_id")
  type        String
  title       String
  message     String
  isRead      Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_read")
  metadata    String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  recipient Employee @relation(fields: [recipientId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)

  @@index([recipientId, isRead])
  @@map("notifications")
}
